faqs.question: How does polyaspartic hold up on outdoor porches against Ontario sun and snow?
faqs.answer: Unlike standard epoxy which quickly turns yellow and chalky under direct UV rays, our porch systems use 100% aliphatic polyaspartic topcoats. They are completely UV-stable, maintain non-slip traction even when wet, and resist freeze-thaw spalling from winter road salt.

faqs.question: How do custom epoxy countertops compare to quartz or granite?
faqs.answer: Our resin countertops are poured seamlessly with zero grout lines or seams to harbor bacteria. They are heat-resistant up to 250°C, 100% food-safe, stain-proof against wine and oils, and can be poured directly over existing laminate, quartz, or wood at 40%–60% lower cost than full demolition.

faqs.question: Can you park hot vehicle tires on your garage floors without peeling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our industrial polyaspartic topcoat has a heat rating up to 150°C. Scorching summer tires coming directly off Highway 401 or Highway 403 will never cause hot-tire pickup, softening, or delamination.

faqs.question: How long does a typical porch or garage installation take?
faqs.answer: Most 2-car garages and front porches are completed in just 1 to 2 days. The rapid-cure polyaspartic topcoat is ready for foot traffic in 6 to 8 hours and vehicle parking after 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.question: What warranty does LAYR EPOXY provide?
faqs.answer: We stand behind our preparation and materials with a written 15-year adhesion and anti-delamination warranty on all residential garage and porch installations in Mississauga.
